title: XDM–Download Manager & Browser
summary: Fast download manager, browser, torrent tools and Secure DNS
description:
XDM is a fast, reliable download manager for Android with a built-in browser, torrent support, media detection, file organization, and optional Secure DNS.

DOWNLOAD MANAGER
• Multi-part downloads for efficient performance
• Pause, resume, retry, and manage downloads
• Background downloading with progress notifications
• Controls for download queues, speed, network use, and file location
• Support for large files and multiple file types

BUILT-IN BROWSER
• Browse and download without switching apps
• Automatically detect downloadable files and supported media
• Choose from multiple search engines
• Use custom user-agent settings and manage browser preferences

TORRENTS AND LINKS
• Add magnet links or torrent URLs
• Import torrent files from device storage
• Select files before starting a torrent download
• Open supported download links shared from other apps

FILE MANAGEMENT
• Organize downloads by category and status
• Find finished, active, queued, and failed downloads
• Open, rename, share, or remove downloaded files
• Use a clean interface designed for phones and tablets

SECURE DNS
Choose a preset DNS provider or configure a custom DNS-over-HTTPS server. You can test a provider before applying it.

How Secure DNS uses Android VpnService:
Secure DNS creates a local Android VpnService tunnel for XDM only and sends XDM's DNS lookups to the DNS-over-HTTPS provider you select. DNS lookups are encrypted between the device and that provider. This feature is not a general-purpose VPN, does not change your location, and does not route traffic from other apps. You can turn it off at any time. DNS queries are handled according to the privacy policy of the selected provider.

PRIVACY AND CONTROL
• No ads
• No unnecessary tracking
• Clear controls for browser, downloads, storage, and permissions

PERMISSIONS
XDM requests permissions only when needed for its features:
• Storage or media access: save and manage downloaded files
• Internet access: browse and download content
• Notifications: show download progress and status
• Install packages: open APK installation only when you request it
• VPN access: enable optional Secure DNS for XDM traffic

IMPORTANT
XDM does not host or provide downloadable content. You are responsible for ensuring that you have permission to access and download any file or media. Features may depend on the source website, server, network, and Android version.
